A moment of stillness at De Singel Arts Centre in Antwerp: ‘Pacifica’, the opening track of the Grammy-nominated album “Chapter II: How Dark it is Before Dawn”.
Directed by Ali Clifton
Music composed and arranged by Anoushka Shankar and Peter Raeburn
Arranged for live performance by Danny Keane
Band:
Arun Ghosh: Clarinet
Pirashanna Thevarajah: Percussion
Sarathy Korwar: Drums
